title: HCP Namespace Deep Dive
description: Shows per-pod and per-container CPU & memory resource breakdown, pod lifecycle, network/disk I/O, etcd health, HCP namespace utilization, and HCP cluster footprint on user nodes in the MGMT cluster.

panels.description: CPU usage rate (cores) per container. Colored by control plane component.

targets.expr: sum by (pod, container) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", container!="", container!="POD"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: CPU Usage per Container

panels.description: How much memory each container is actively using (doesn't include reclaimable cache).

targets.expr: sum by (pod, container) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", container!="", container!="POD"})

panels.title: Memory Working Set per Container

panels.description: Memory working set per container (actual usage from cadvisor metrics)
panels.title: Memory Usage per Container

panels.description: Memory requests per container from kube-state-metrics (pod spec resource requests). HCPs have NO limits, only requests. Tiers: small=8Gi, medium=16Gi, large=32Gi, xlarge=64Gi, xxlarge=96Gi

targets.expr: sum by (container) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", resource="memory", container!="", container!="POD"})

panels.title: Memory Requests per Container

panels.description: CPU usage (cores) aggregated per pod over time. Spot which pod is driving CPU load without the per-container noise.
panels.title: CPU Usage per Pod (cores)

panels.description: Memory working set aggregated per pod over time (excludes reclaimable cache).
panels.title: Memory Working Set per Pod

panels.description: Current CPU usage per pod, sorted highest first.
panels.title: Current CPU Usage per Pod

panels.description: Current memory working set per pod, sorted highest first.
panels.title: Current Memory Usage per Pod

panels.description: How many pods are in each state right now (Running, Pending, Failed, Succeeded).
panels.title: Current Pod Phase

panels.description: Container restarts in the last hour per pod (more useful for triage than total restarts since pod started).
panels.title: Container Restart Count per Pod

panels.description: OOMKilled events timeline. Note: changes() counts value transitions not discrete events - may miss kills between scrapes.
panels.title: OOMKilled Events Timeline

panels.description: Why each container exited last time (OOMKilled, Error, Completed, etc).
panels.title: Last Terminated Reason per Container

panels.description: How much network traffic each pod is receiving.
panels.title: Network Receive Bytes per Pod

panels.description: How much network traffic each pod is sending out.
panels.title: Network Transmit Bytes per Pod

panels.description: Network errors (both receiving and sending) - sustained errors mean there's a network problem.
panels.title: Network Error Rate per Pod

panels.description: Persistent volume usage per PVC in the namespace (from kubelet_volume_stats_used_bytes). Shows actual disk usage for each etcd data volume.
panels.title: Filesystem Usage per Volume

panels.description: How fast each container is reading from disk.

targets.expr: sum by (pod, container) (rate(container_fs_reads_bytes_total{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", container!="", container!="POD"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Disk Read Bytes per Container

panels.description: How fast each container is writing to disk.

targets.expr: sum by (pod, container) (rate(container_fs_writes_bytes_total{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", container!="", container!="POD"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Disk Write Bytes per Container

panels.description: p99 WAL fsync latency per etcd member. Warning at 10ms, critical at 20ms. Azure rarely meets the etcd-recommended 10ms SLO, and latency varies by region.
panels.title: etcd Disk WAL fsync Latency (p99)

panels.description: Size of the etcd database (warning at 2GB, critical at 8GB near quota limit).
panels.title: etcd DB Size

panels.description: How many times the etcd leader changed in the last hour (frequent changes = instability).
panels.title: etcd Leader Changes (Last 1h)
HCP Namespace Resource Footprint on MGMT Cluster

panels.description: Total CPU usage (cores) for the selected HCP namespace over time.
panels.title: HCP Namespace CPU Usage (cores)

panels.description: Total memory working set for the selected HCP namespace over time.
panels.title: HCP Namespace Memory Usage

panels.description: Total network I/O (receive + transmit) for the selected HCP namespace over time.
panels.title: HCP Namespace Network I/O

panels.description: CPU usage of the selected HCP namespace on each user (userswft) node as a percentage of that node's allocatable CPU. Shows how the HCP workload is distributed across user (userswft) nodes.

targets.expr:
sum by (node) (
  label_replace(
    rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", container!="", container!="POD"}[$__rate_interval]),
    "node", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+)(:.*)?"
  )
)
/ on(node)
max by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{cluster="$cluster", resource="cpu", node=~"aks-user.*"})
* 100

panels.title: HCP Namespace CPU % per user (userswft) Node

panels.description: Memory working set of the selected HCP namespace on each user (userswft) node as a percentage of that node's allocatable memory. Shows how the HCP workload is distributed across user (userswft) nodes.

targets.expr:
sum by (node) (
  label_replace(
    container_memory_working_set_bytes{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", container!="", container!="POD"},
    "node", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+)(:.*)?"
  )
)
/ on(node)
max by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{cluster="$cluster", resource="memory", node=~"aks-user.*"})
* 100

panels.title: HCP Namespace Memory % per user (userswft) Node
Current Overall MGMT Cluster Node Utilization

panels.description: Current CPU utilization per MGMT cluster node as a percentage of allocatable capacity. Helps identify hot nodes.

targets.expr:
sum by (node) (label_replace(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{cluster="$cluster", container!="", container!="POD"}[$__rate_interval]), "node", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+)(:.*)?"))
/ on(node)
max by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{cluster="$cluster", resource="cpu"})
* 100

panels.title: CPU Utilization per Node (% of Allocatable)

panels.description: Current memory utilization per MGMT cluster node as a percentage of allocatable capacity. Helps identify hot nodes.

targets.expr:
sum by (node) (label_replace(container_memory_working_set_bytes{cluster="$cluster", container!="", container!="POD"}, "node", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+)(:.*)?"))
/ on(node)
max by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{cluster="$cluster", resource="memory"})
* 100

panels.title: Memory Utilization per Node (% of Allocatable)
